title: A pairtime track loop and a mouse jiggler on Windows

records.why: DESIGN 5.4's four conditions hold: the chain reaches the session the focused terminal hosts, the jiggler gave input in the 30 s before, the last anchor is more than 20 s back, and no hook or log reader sees the session. Level C: no keyboard input in the 10 s before (6.4). A track record never counts toward logged_s or ai_logged_s (D19).
